component.name: beaM.
component.summary: Professional, non-destructive RAW photo editor and library manager
Profesyonel, tahribatsız RAW fotoğraf düzenleyicisi ve kütüphane yöneticisi

description.p: beaM. is an independent, high-performance desktop photographic darkroom and asset manager built in 100% pure Rust, powered by wgpu and egui.
beaM., saf Rust diliyle sıfırdan geliştirilmiş, wgpu ve egui altyapısıyla çalışan bağımsız ve yüksek performanslı masaüstü RAW fotoğraf düzenleme yazılımıdır.

ul.li: GPU-accelerated non-destructive 32-bit floating point color pipeline
RawTherapee-style in-app directory navigator with places, bookmarks, and subfolder browsing
Tone mapping, white balance (temperature/tint), HSL 8-band color equalizer, sharpening, and contrast
Non-destructive .beam sidecar architecture and standalone project saving
Batch exporter with Lanczos3 resampling and custom naming templates
GPU hızlandırmalı tahribatsız 32-bit kayan nokta renk işleme hattı
RawTherapee tarzı yerleşik dosya gezgini, hızlı erişim konumları ve yer imleri
Ton eğrisi, beyaz dengesi, 8 bantlı HSL renk dengeleyici ve keskinleştirme
Tahribatsız .beam yan dosya mimarisi ve bağımsız proje kaydetme
Lanczos3 ölçekleme ve şablonlu toplu dışa aktarıcı

description.p: beaM. 1.2.5: Local 5x5 edge-preserving Smart Denoise, Auto Sky & Auto Subject segmentation masks, and CLI Plugin Architecture.

beaM. 1.2.0: True 16-bit GPU export and ICC-embedded TIFFs, Manual Lens & Perspective correction, Soft Proofing with Out-of-Gamut & Focus Peaking overlays, Waveform/RGB Parade/Vectorscope, Brush/Luminance/Color Range masks, Camera Profiles, Named Snapshots, Tags, Smart Collections, IPTC/XMP Metadata & GPS Map links, Duplicate Detection, and Tethered Watch.

beaM. 1.1.0: Rgba16Float 3D LUT accuracy fix, HDR highlight preservation in Tone Curve and HSL, halo-padded tiled export with global UV coordinates, aspect-corrected straighten geometry, race-free async image loading, sidecar-safe undo/redo and library sync, and SQLite security update.

beaM. 1.0.0: Whites/Blacks, Vibrance/Saturation, Vignette/Grain, WB Eyedropper, RGB Tone Curves, 3-Way Color Grading Wheels, Detail (Clarity/Dehaze/Sharpening/NR), 3D .cube LUTs, Parametric GPU Masking, Histogram Auto Tone, Virtual Copies, 16-bit TIFF & WebP Export, and Watermarking.
beaM. 0.8.0: Studio UI modernization, strict layout alignment, CPU and memory footprint optimizations, instant folder scan, and 8-bit fast-path thumbnailing.
beaM. 0.2.0: Added RawTherapee file browser, cross-platform packaging system (.deb, .rpm, .AppImage, Windows installer and portable zip), and .beam format standardization.
Introduced RawTherapee-style file browser, .beam extension standardization, unsaved changes confirmation dialog, and parser robustness hardening.
Initial public release of beaM. featuring non-destructive editing and wgpu pipeline.
